rows.note: Use 舊 as the all-purpose choice for a nonliving thing that is old, used, or previous; use 過時 when the point is obsolescence.

example.english: This computer is quite old now.
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 din6 nou5 ji5 ging1 hou2 gau6 laa3

rows.note: Use 老 for a living being that has reached advanced age, rather than 舊 or the numeric-age construction.

example.english: That dog is very old now.
example.jyutping: go2 zek3 gau2 ji5 ging1 hou2 lou5 laa3

rows.note: Use A 歲 to state that someone or something is a specified number of years old.

example.english: My son is ten years old this year.
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 zai2 gam1 nin4 sap6 seoi3

rows.note: Use 過時 specifically when something is outdated or no longer current, rather than merely old or previously owned.

example.english: This phone model is old and outdated now.
example.jyutping: ni1 fun2 sau2 gei1 ji5 ging1 gwo3 si4 laa3
